model.near_field_candidate: Pairwise linear fundamental monopole feedback using local table secant compliance; cubic signed correlation blend; harmonics 2-8 unchanged
model.near_field_limits: Not a collective radial response, multipole theory or calibrated near-field solution; Primary remains the uncoupled table Primary
model.feedback_window: Cubic smoothstep: 1 at d<=Ri+Rj; 0 at d>=4(Ri+Rj)
model.zero_drive_compliance: Lowest valid table-pressure secant; exact zero total drive still has zero response
model.contact_candidate: Frozen local normal-mobility tensors; symmetric pair H=(Mi+Mj)/2; equal/opposite correction overlap*H*n/(2*n.H*n), with fixed Jacobi relaxation
model.acoustic_domain: required only with nonzero enabled PZT drive
model.contact_metric: inherited diagonal central PBD; not full RPY constrained dynamics

summary.mobility_scope: Two inherited local Jacobi iterations plus component mean balance; pair lubrication from ambient differences is approximate, not a global Stokes solve

microbubble.positive_gap_interpretation: No denominator floor; near machine-zero positive gaps produce min closing time3.4e-14s and very large dt/closing ratios. Projection enforces a geometric budget; this does not establish temporally resolved lubrication/contact physics.
microbubble.baseline_actual_displacement_per_step: UNAVAILABLE; baseline diagnostic field max_physical_substep_displacement is actually pre-projection prediction, verified source kernels.py predict(); never relabel it accepted displacement
microbubble.RK_stage_scope: NOT_APPLICABLE: this actual F6/F7 branch is Euler prediction +12 contact passes, not old RK tracker. Per-pass and endpoint-net projection explicitly distinct.
microbubble.stage_model_scope: Mature initial cluster persists across 0–1s; no de-novo cluster-formation or whole6s claim
microbubble.not_run: No full baseline rerun, no max_displacement_per_radius sweep: this actual backend has no such cap
microbubble.files_missing_or_schema_replaced: F7 uses CONFIG/IDENTITY/SUMMARY plus trajectory.h5; old particles/events.jsonl/PHYSICS_BANNER names not present. Equivalent actual metadata audited, no invented files.
microbubble.internal_trajectory_timestep_status: NOT_ESTABLISHED: multi-radius same-ID divergence despite stable cluster size/COM; no certified cluster AI labels
microbubble.allowed_AI_labels: NO_CERTIFIED_CLUSTER_AI_LABELS; retain audit observables as exploratory records only
